DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease (specifically Right-to-Left shunt or severe failure leading to hepatomegaly and edema)

I have reviewed your repeated statement; however, Multiple Sclerosis cannot explain your liver enlargement, pitting edema, or rapid breathing, which are classic signs of systemic heart failure or fluid overload. Since standard autoimmune and liver workups are negative, and you have no history of congenital defects or failure to thrive, please confirm if you have observed any cyanosis (bluish tint) to your lips or fingers, or if your breathing becomes significantly worse when you lie flat.
